His touchdown was the cherry on top, and fantasy managers should expect him to continue to see considerable work moving forward, even while sharing the backfield with Kyren Williams.

news.contents: New York Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers saw his fantasy stock hit a brief skid early in the season when he was recovering from an injury and still adapting to the quarterback play of Jameis Winston. Branch was not targeted at all in the team's Week 8 shutout loss to the division-rival Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday before injuring his hamstring, and he could be facing a multi-week absence.
